source.title: Fast Inference from Transformers via Speculative Decoding

license.changes: Cropped from the original figure. Source colors and geometry are preserved.

teaching.spokenAnchor: Inspect the first candidate using the target row for the original prefix. If it survives, inspect the next candidate using the next conditional row. At the first rejection, discard that token and every later draft token, then sample a correction at the rejected prefix.
teaching.moment: Follow the accepted draft prefix, the first rejected token and its correction into the next iteration.
teaching.scope: Use original v1 as pinned in the lesson. The source trace is illustrative and does not establish factual checking or a deployment speedup.
teaching.caption: Green tokens are accepted, red tokens rejected, and blue tokens supply the correction.
